description.value: Uptown Pizza & Sports Bar is Nelson's self-described only dedicated sports bar, housed within the Adventure Hotel on Vernon Street in the heart of downtown. The venue features wall-to-wall flat screens, a rotating lineup of BC craft beers on tap from breweries like Mt. Begbie, Four Winds, and Fernie Brewing, and a full pub menu of hand-made pizzas, burgers, and wings prepared by an in-house chef. Touring cyclists can also take advantage of takeout and delivery service if they prefer to eat elsewhere.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: bollard (2 spaces) at 32m; bollard (2 spaces) at 39m. Total: 4 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at adventurehotel.ca confirms the business at 616 Vernon St, Nelson, BC V1L 4G1, matching the OSM address. The OSM website tag (www.newgrandhotel.ca/) is outdated — the business now operates under the Adventure Hotel brand at adventurehotel.ca; the OSM name 'Uptown Sportsbar' also differs from the website's 'Uptown Pizza & Sports Bar'. Takeout is explicitly confirmed by the website; bike parking, washrooms, and most other amenities are not mentioned anywhere in the fetched content.
